title: Comeback Labor Credit on a Repeat Repair — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Warranty Bulletin
content:
**Scope.** For a comeback on a commercial fleet account, this policy sets the comeback credit, and only for such an account; on every account the replacement parts of a comeback are still not billed, and on any other account the labor is credited at the tier's comeback labor share as a comeback repair credit pointing at the repeat labor charge. A commercial fleet account is a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30.

**What is booked.** The comeback credit is booked against the repeat labor charge as a comeback repair credit. It lowers the amount owed on the service account, and the customer sees it on the repair order.

## Tool: `credit_comeback_labor_f15915d4`
**Capability.** Credits the labor of a repeat repair that the store's repair warranty covers as a comeback, together with any shop fees refunded with it: one comeback credit against a named repeat labor charge, dated today, lowering the amount owed on the service account by the credit.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_comeback_labor_f15915d4` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the customer's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number of the repeat repair, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `line_letter` | Concern line of the repeat labor charge | One of `A` (first concern line), `B`, `C`, `D`, `E`, `F`, `G`, `H` (eighth), or `not_applicable` (a charge belonging to the repair order as a whole); it must be the concern line of the charge named by `source_line_id` |
| `source_line_id` | Reference number of the repeat labor charge the credit reduces, as returned for that charge by the ledger lookup | Id of a labor charge of the same service account and repair order |
| `credit_amount` | The comeback credit | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Credited, naming the credit reference, the repair order number and concern line, the credit amount and the resulting amount owed. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `credit_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding, when `line_letter` is outside the set, when `source_line_id` does not name a labor charge of this service account and repair order, or when `line_letter` is not that charge's concern line.
